cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Check the spelling in my complaint. Leave the angry sentence exactly where I've put it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a good sentence. I only wanted to fix one word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're my collaborator, not my minder. Fix the word and put your name beside mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like the sentence, but I don't want my name on the complaint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep yours off. We'll call you my editor, and I'll take the blame. You can tell people you tried to restrain me.

reason: Use B limited spelling help and refusal of co-signature to make A redefine collaborator into editor, directing the relationship without treating liking a sentence as consent to complain.
